exposure: previous history of two or more live births (parity)
outcome: feeding solid, semisolid, or soft foods to 6-8-month-olds
cohort: The study included 682 ultra-poor mothers with 0-23-months-old children living in the slums of Dhaka and Saidpur, Bangladesh.
finding: The study found that while most children were ever breastfed, exclusive breastfeeding needs improvement and bottle feeding needs reduction, with maternal education, parity, and cesarean delivery significantly associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with a lower likelihood of early initiation of breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: Mothers with children aged 0-23 months were interviewed at a single point in time.
